FEAT-3-S127.title: Clinical Trials Input/Output Schema Validation
FEAT-3-S127.description: Define and enforce Pydantic schemas for clinical trial search inputs (condition, location, radius) and outputs (trial metadata, sites, travel metrics) ensuring strict contract validation at tool boundary.

FEAT-3-S128.title: EvaluateCare Facade Integration for Clinical Trials
FEAT-3-S128.description: Integrate clinical_trials_service into evaluate_care_facade to orchestrate end-to-end flow from validated input through search, enrichment, and formatted response delivery.

FEAT-3-S129.title: Tool Router Exposure for Clinical Trials Search
FEAT-3-S129.description: Expose clinical trials search as an allowlisted tool in tool_router with proper schema binding, enabling LLM tool-use invocation and safe dispatch.

FEAT-3-S130.title: Unit Tests for Clinical Trials Service Logic
FEAT-3-S130.description: Implement unit tests covering query construction, recruiting filter enforcement, location normalization, and distance computation including edge cases (missing coordinates, empty results).

FEAT-3-S131.title: End-to-End Integration Test via Chat Tooling
FEAT-3-S131.description: Create integration test simulating LLM-driven tool invocation through tool_router to validate full pipeline from user query to formatted clinical trial results returned in chat.
